en: Remulos, old friend. It is good to see you once more. I knew that the message would find its way to you - one way or another.
I am sorry $c, but you need to be more experienced before you can survive in Alterac Valley.
%s lets out a battlecry!
%s looks very sleepy...

You are dutiful to inquire, $c, but all Horde collections have been completed. We now wait for the Alliance hegemony to finish theirs, and then all will be transported to Silithus in the vicinity of Cenarion Hold.
What do you ask of me?
No tampering with the mail!
Where is Elder Obsidian?
Whatcha need, $c?  I trust that you've come out to this wasteland for a reason other than idle chit chat.
We barely have any supplies to build Frostwolf Keep.  We'll need many, many more before we can repair our base and reenter the battle.
Bat man on upper level of Trade Quarter.
Attack, my sisters! The troll must not escape!
The Alliance has taken the Coldtooth Mine!
Farewell.

This here is the finest, most state of the art mode of transportation money can build. What? Deeprun Tram? Gnomes? Listen pal, If you believe that garbage then I've got a statue down in Stranglethorn to sell ya. Now, are you walking to Grom'Gol or are you gonna ride in style in this fine flying machine? Your choice.
There, there, $n, worry not! Which piece of the amulet have you misplaced?$B$BDid you check all of your bags and the bank?

Ah, so you have. You are most welcome in Ironforge, $c. 

This city is the seat of the Bronzebeard Clan. We are an ancient and proud people and our craftsmen are second to none. You'll find no finer creations of metal or stonework than dwarven-make.

We are also amongst boldest of explorers on Azeroth. If you have a taste for adventure, you will be in good company amongst our people.

Thank you for speaking with me, $N. Go now with the blessings of the Bronzebeard Clan. 

I wish you and your people well.
You dare set foot upon Hakkari holy ground? Minions of Hakkar, destroy the infidels!
Yaaaaawwwwwnnnn...
Ah, good.  These spores have rendered nicely.  Thank you, $n.
All right people, look alive!
%s attacks Karang's Banner!
If Gnoarn finds out about this, it'll be my hide!
No stealing the goods!
Run! They are coming!
1 minute until the battle for Alterac Valley begins.
Can you give me directions?

You must remember that while this realm has been our home for millennia, we will always be somewhat alien to this place. We are not in the terrestrial world that birthed our people. We are in the realm of Skywall, a part of the elemental plane.$B$BWe arrived here as the guests of spirits with whom we found common cause in ages past. Now that we Shen'dorei find ourselves bereft of their presence--and potentially--their protection, there's no telling how the other denizens of this plane may perceive us.
Whatcha need?
This $C intrudes on our work! Die fool!
That's troll business.  Look for Un'Thuwa in Sen'jin Village down south.
Soon, young ones. Soon the armies of the Horde will arrive. We march. March to the cursed gates and crush all in our way. Let them feel the might of Kalimdor!
You are no match for the strength of the Horde!
To win this war, we can't sit idle and let the tides sweep us over.  We must strike, hard and fast, or Arathi will never again be ours.
There are quite a few trainers available in Elwynn.  Which one are you looking for?
If you have what it takes, I will be happy to show you the way.
Good work, $n!  Complete your trial by speaking with me.  Time continues to slip away until you do so!
Alms for the poor?
Course I can show ye where Myolor is. Right over there near the anvil of the Great Forge, that's where he does his work. Listen to his words well $g lad:lass;, Myolor is as skilled as they come.
%s continues his meditations...
Something big's coming out from the hive, ma'am.  Headed straight for us.
